summary: Create a Change Order Change Reason
description: Create a New Change Order Change Reason for a Company

id.description: Unique string identifier for the change reason. Use as the {id} path parameter to update or delete this change reason.

change_reason.description: Human-readable label describing why a change order was raised (e.g. Allowance, Client Request).

show_in_select.description: When true, this reason appears in change-reason dropdowns in the UI; when false it is hidden from selection.

deletable.description: True when the reason can be safely deleted; false when it is still referenced by existing change orders.
